description: This file implements utilities for handling UNIX domain sockets, including sending and receiving messages with file descriptors and credentials, and managing control messages.

classes.name: ControlMessage
classes.description: Represents a control message used in socket communication, capable of handling file descriptors and credentials.

classes.name: UnixSocketMessage
classes.description: Encapsulates a message sent over a UNIX socket, including data and control messages.

classes.name: UnixMessageSocket
classes.description: Provides an interface for sending and receiving messages over a UNIX socket, including support for credentials and file descriptors.

methods.name: ControlMessage::FromRaw
methods.description: Creates a ControlMessage object from a raw cmsghdr pointer.

methods.name: ControlMessage::FromFileDescriptors
methods.description: Creates a ControlMessage containing file descriptors.

methods.name: ControlMessage::IsCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the control message contains credentials (Linux-specific).

methods.name: ControlMessage::AsCredentials
methods.description: Extracts credentials from the control message (Linux-specific).

methods.name: ControlMessage::IsFileDescriptors
methods.description: Checks if the control message contains file descriptors.

methods.name: ControlMessage::AsSharedFDs
methods.description: Retrieves shared file descriptors from the control message.

methods.name: UnixSocketMessage::HasFileDescriptors
methods.description: Checks if the message contains file descriptors.

methods.name: UnixSocketMessage::FileDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves all file descriptors from the message.

methods.name: UnixSocketMessage::HasCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the message contains credentials (Linux-specific).

methods.name: UnixMessageSocket::UnixMessageSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket and retrieves its maximum message size.

methods.name: UnixMessageSocket::EnableCredentials
methods.description: Enables or disables credential passing on the socket (Linux-specific).

methods.name: UnixMessageSocket::WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over the socket, including control messages.

methods.name: UnixMessageSocket::ReadMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the socket, including control messages.
